O(n+s), no simulated permutation enumeration.

targets.review_note: Network flow represents sticker inventory and legal exchanges. Source supplies Bob copies, each type has one sink slot, friends accept at most one of each missing type and give only their surplus copies. Flow conservation enforces equal exchange counts and permits chains through duplicate types. Residual reverse edges support reallocating earlier exchanges.
